class.name: SVGRope3D
class.brief_description: PBD rope that bends an SVG ribbon in 3D, or draws a plain ribbon line.
class.description: The top particle is at the node origin. SVG mode maps horizontal slices of [member src] along the particle centerline. [member line_mode] uses the same solver without requiring an SVG.

method.name: get_rope_points
method.description: Returns the current local-space PBD particle positions.

method.name: reset_simulation
method.description: Places all particles in a straight top-to-bottom rest pose.
